FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 272
Committee: Constitution, Campaigns and Sponsor: Representative Jim Carns
Elections
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/03/2026
House Bill 272 as introduced could reduce election expenses paid from the State General Fund
by an estimated $750,000 to $1,350,000 over each 4-year election cycle, beginning in fiscal year
2027 by allowing the judges of probate to publish registered voter lists through alternative
means when the cost exceeds a certain cost threshold. Prior to 2030, this bill establishes this
threshold at $40,000.
Beginning fiscal year 2030, this threshold cap would be adjusted annually in accordance with
the Consumer Price Index.
